net_distributable_income.verbatim_line: Income available for distribution for the current year | 67,874 ; Distribution of other gains | 7,928
net_distributable_income.note: For-year amount added to the distributable pool BEFORE opening carry = current-year income available (67,874) + distribution of other gains (7,928) = 75,802. Equals disclosed cumulative 'Amount available for distribution to Stapled Securityholders' 124,605 minus opening 48,803. The cumulative 124,605 line is the trap (folds in opening carry) and is NOT used as B. Existing performance.json net_distributable_income (67,874) is the Core taxable+tax-exempt income line only; the rollforward B must include the 7,928 other-gains release for the A+B-P=E identity to close.

distribution_cash_paid.note: Total distributions actually PAID during FY2025 across three tranches crossing fiscal years (2H2024 paid in 2025, 1H2025, and advance 1 Jul-19 Aug 2025). This is cash paid, distinct from the FY2025 declared/DPU basis.

distributable_income_closing.verbatim_line: Amount available for distribution to Stapled Securityholders at end of the year | 37,131

distribution_paid_declared.note: No single absolute FY2025-declared distribution amount is disclosed as a line in the audited Distribution Statement; only DPU 3.70 cents is stated. The statement lists cash tranches paid (total 87,474) rather than a declared-for-year figure, so declared amount is left null (AR-only, not imputed).

rollforward.notes: Audited Distribution Statement of the Stapled Group, FY ended 31 December 2025 (page 152). A=48,803 (opening) + B=75,802 (current-year income 67,874 + other gains 7,928) - P=87,474 (total tranches paid) = 37,131 = E (closing). Guard closes exactly (0 diff). Amounts in $'000 in source, stored here as raw SGD integers. Income available for distribution of the Stapled Group is contributed solely by Far East H-REIT Group (page 153).

txns.property_name: Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport
txns.gain_basis: vs_valuation (DERIVED, acquisition discount): purchase price JPY 6,000m vs independent valuation JPY 7,790m as at 31 Dec 2025 (CBRE, discounted cash flow method); (6,000-7,790)/7,790 = -22.98%. Negative = acquired ~23% below year-end independent valuation (favourable to buyer). No premium/discount % disclosed verbatim in AR; derived from disclosed purchase price and valuation. Gain concepts (gain_on_divestment/net proceeds) are N/A for an acquisition.
